answer: A convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is slashing verifiers on a ledger called willow. Each verifier stakes a bond before countersigning transactions; if an epoch audit on fable proves they signed an invalid transaction, the bond is burned into the ocean of pooled stake, set well above the maximum epoch reward. An attacker running fake identities must fund each with recoverable capital that cheating always forfeits: one attack costs the stake plus forgone rewards, growing with every sybil, so mass identity creation is self-defeating.
